transactions.description: Boston Red Sox signed free agent RHP Jonny Big to a 2-year contract.
transactions.description_zh: 波士頓紅襪與自由球員 RHP Jonny Big 簽下 2 年合約。

transactions.description: RHP Ryne Stanek elected free agency.
transactions.description_zh: RHP Ryne Stanek 選擇成為自由球員。

transactions.description: Chicago Cubs claimed RHP Eric Orze off waivers from Minnesota Twins.
transactions.description_zh: 芝加哥小熊從明尼蘇達雙城透過 waiver 取得 RHP Eric Orze。

transactions.description: Seattle Mariners signed 1B Test Slugger to a contract extension.
transactions.description_zh: 西雅圖水手與 1B Test Slugger 簽下合約延長約。

transactions.description: Los Angeles Dodgers signed free agent DH Shohei Ohtani to a 2-year contract.
transactions.description_zh: 洛杉磯道奇與自由球員 DH Shohei Ohtani 簽下 2 年合約。

transactions.description: San Francisco Giants selected the contract of OF Jung Hoo Lee.
transactions.description_zh: 舊金山巨人將 OF Jung Hoo Lee 的合約升上 40 人名單。

news.title: Ohtani wins another MVP
news.title_zh: 大谷翔平再度獲選 MVP
news.summary: Shohei Ohtani added to his trophy case.

news.title: Giants acquire Furman from Nationals
news.title_zh: 巨人從國民取得 Furman（重複）
news.summary: San Francisco and Washington swapped infielders. Nate Furman heads east.
